# CacheSession { #pymc_cache.CacheSession }

```python
CacheSession(
    cache=True,
    *,
    model=None,
    policy=None,
    namespace='',
    model_key=None,
    sampler_key=None,
)
```

Compute identity and check a cache before beginning costly sampling.

Reuse the returned CacheLookup with :meth:`store` after sampling completes.
This API lets a remote caller avoid provisioning a container on a hit.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [lookup](#pymc_cache.CacheSession.lookup) | Return a hit, a storable miss, or a safe uncacheable miss. |
| [store](#pymc_cache.CacheSession.store) | Publish only if graph and result still match the preflight identity. |

### lookup { #pymc_cache.CacheSession.lookup }

```python
CacheSession.lookup(
    sample_kwargs,
    *,
    operation='sample',
    overwrite=False,
    versions=None,
    sampler_identity=None,
)
```

Return a hit, a storable miss, or a safe uncacheable miss.

### store { #pymc_cache.CacheSession.store }

```python
CacheSession.store(lookup, idata, *, status='complete', effective_sampler=None)
```

Publish only if graph and result still match the preflight identity.
